item.title: Getting Started with Hugo: A Beginner's Guide
item.description:
Introduction

Hugo is a fast and flexible static site generator. In this article, I’ll share my experience getting started with Hugo.

What is Hugo?

Hugo is an open-source static site generator written in Go. It’s known for its incredible speed and flexibility.

Why Choose Hugo?

  1. Lightning Fast: Build times in milliseconds
  2. Flexible: Supports multiple content types
  3. Easy to Use: Simple templating and configuration
